description: Geological history of the planet (experiment E07): timeline, ocean spreading parameters and continental provinces. Coordinates [longitude, latitude] in degrees; ages in million years before present (Ma).

timeline.event: Oldest cratons form: Ulthos, Sothoryos, the Land of Always Winter
Shield of the North of Westeros and the Dothraki craton stabilise
Breakup of an older supercontinent; the proto-narrow sea opens between Westeros and Essos
Northern collision: the proto-narrow sea closes in the north; the northern mountains, the Frostfangs core, Skagos and Ibben are folded

Assembly of the last supercontinent: Westeros, Essos, Sothoryos and the southern continent join; the Mountains of the Moon and the hills of western Essos rise on both sides of the closed proto-narrow sea; the western and eastern blocks of Essos collide along the Bone Mountains
timeline.analogue: Variscan and Appalachian orogenies; Uralian orogeny (Late Carboniferous to Triassic)

timeline.event: The supercontinent breaks up: the Sunset Sea widens from its central ridge; the west coast of Westeros becomes a passive margin
timeline.analogue: breakup of Pangaea, central Atlantic (~180 Ma); oldest ocean floor ~180 Ma

timeline.event: The southern continent separates from Sothoryos: the South Sunset ridge opens a slow southern ocean
Ulthos separates from Sothoryos and the south polar continent and starts north
Dorne collides with Westeros: the Red Mountains rise; Sothoryos starts to close the Summer Sea
timeline.analogue: Pyrenees, Iberia against Europe (Late Cretaceous to Miocene)

timeline.event: Collision belt along southern Essos: Painted Mountains, Ghiscar and Lhazar hills; plateau uplift east of the Bone Mountains
The narrow sea reopens along the old suture between Westeros and Essos (a Wilson cycle)
timeline.analogue: Red Sea (spreading for ~13 Myr); the Atlantic reopening along the Iapetus suture

timeline.event: Far-field push of the southern collisions lifts the Bone Mountains again
timeline.analogue: Tian Shan, lifted since the Miocene ~2 000 km from the India-Asia suture

timeline.event: Rifting in eastern Essos: the Bleeding Sea basin
Ulthos meets the Jade Sea arcs; the Valyrian arc grows above the Summer Sea trench
timeline.analogue: Australia entering the Banda arc (~3 Ma); Aegean arc

timeline.event: The Doom: caldera collapse of the Fourteen Flames floods the Valyrian peninsula (in-world ~400 years ago)

province_codes.3: old orogen (Proterozoic or Palaeozoic mobile belt)
